Maya (docs): Heads-up: drafting a short migration note for removing /v1/invoke. Plan: one-paragraph notice, two tiny examples (JS + curl), and a checklist for customers. Target public notice Aug 1.

Jin (sdk): I can add a compact JS snippet showing old->new mapping and a compat header. Will call out model pinning (recommend model@YYYY-MM-DD).

Zoe (prod): Add a brief fallback section: if model@version not found, we route to alias and emit fallback.metric. Also include a canary header example (X-Canary:1).

Maya (docs): good. keep wording "deprecated" and include enterprise contact for Dedicated. Can someone paste snippets here?

Jin (sdk): ```js
// v1 -> v2 minimal map
const v1 = { model: "rwd-tiny", input: "hi" }
const v2 = { model: `${v1.model}@2024-08-01`, input: v1.input }
client.responses.create(v2, { headers: { 'X-Migrate-From': 'v1' } })
```

Jin (sdk): curl: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/responses -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model":"rwd-tiny@2024-08-01","input":"hi"}'`

Zoe (prod): Note in doc: if you rely on implicit aliasing, verify embedding dims and token counts after migration. Also include rollback steps (switch back to alias without @version).

ops-bot: PR opened -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5710 (draft: v1 invoke deprecation).

Maya (docs): Thanks. Action items: Jin -> add Python snippet in PR (today), Zoe -> update runbook/banner (by Jul 25), Maya -> final copy and publish (Jul 28).
